import hashlib,json,os,subprocess
from datetime import datetime,timezone
from pathlib import Path
ROOTS=['/public/home/zqchen/projects/ECNU_EYU_data/work_space/S2/experimental_unvalidated/s2_p3_f0_second_member_20261111_r1', '/public/home/zqchen/projects/ECNU_EYU_data/work_space/S2/experimental_unvalidated/s2_p3_wave2_20261104_r5', '/public/home/zqchen/projects/ECNU_EYU_data/work_space/S2/experimental_unvalidated/s2_p4_oof_postproc_20261111_r3', '/public/home/zqchen/projects/ECNU_EYU_data/work_space/S2/experimental_unvalidated/s2_rc_audit_20261111_r1', '/public/home/zqchen/projects/ECNU_EYU_data/work_space/S2/experimental_unvalidated/s2_rc_audit_20261112_r2', '/public/home/zqchen/projects/ECNU_EYU_data/work_space/S2/experimental_unvalidated/s2_rc_generator_probe_20261112_r1', '/public/home/zqchen/projects/ECNU_EYU_data/work_space/S2/experimental_unvalidated/s2_rc_train_batch1_20261112_r1']
IDS=['4388788', '4388789', '4388790', '4388791', '4388792', '4388793', '4388794', '4388795', '4388796', '4388797', '4388798', '4388799', '4388800', '4388852', '4388854', '4388855', '4388856', '4388857', '4388865', '4388866', '4388867', '4388913', '4388914', '4388915', '4389056', '4389057', '4389058', '4389059', '4389060', '4389061', '4389062', '4389063', '4389064', '4389065', '4389066', '4389067', '4389068', '4389069', '4389070', '4389071', '4389072', '4389074', '4389075', '4389076', '4389106', '4389107', '4389551', '4389552', '4389553', '4389554', '4389555', '4389556', '4389557', '4389558', '4389559', '4389560', '4389561', '4389562', '4389563', '4389564', '4389565', '4389566', '4389567', '4389568', '4389569', '4389570', '4389571', '4389572', '4389573', '4389574', '4389575', '4389576']
def sha(p):
    h=hashlib.sha256()
    with p.open('rb') as f:
        for b in iter(lambda:f.read(1048576),b''):h.update(b)
    return h.hexdigest()
files=[]
errors=[]
for name in ROOTS:
    root=Path(name)
    if not root.is_dir() or root.is_symlink() or root.resolve()!=root:
        errors.append('Root missing or redirected: '+name)
        continue
    for directory,dirs,names in os.walk(root,followlinks=False):
        d=Path(directory)
        depth=len(d.relative_to(root).parts)
        dirs[:]=[x for x in dirs if not x.startswith('.') and not (d/x).is_symlink()
            and x not in {'data','dataset','datasets','weights','checkpoints','models','predictions','probabilities','cache','__pycache__'}]
        if depth>=3:dirs[:]=[]
        for n in sorted(names):
            p=d/n
            if p.suffix.lower()!='.md' or p.is_symlink() or not p.is_file():continue
            size=p.stat().st_size
            if size>2097152:
                errors.append('Markdown exceeds per-file budget: '+str(p));continue
            files.append(dict(root=name,relative_path=p.relative_to(root).as_posix(),path=str(p),bytes=size,sha256=sha(p)))
files.sort(key=lambda x:x['path'])
if len(files)>200 or sum(f['bytes'] for f in files)>20971520:errors.append('Markdown total budget exceeded')
p=subprocess.run(['sacct','-n','-P','-j',','.join(IDS),'--format=JobID,JobName%120,State,ExitCode,Elapsed,Submit,Start,End'],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=45)
if p.returncode:errors.append('Accounting query failed')
print(json.dumps(dict(status='pass' if not errors else 'review_incomplete',remote_utc=datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
    roots=ROOTS,files=files,total_bytes=sum(f['bytes'] for f in files),errors=errors,
    accounting=dict(returncode=p.returncode,stdout=p.stdout,stderr=p.stderr),
    scope='Markdown only; no dataset, model, script execution or job changes'),sort_keys=True))
